description: This PHP source file defines a client class for the AWS RDS DataService, providing methods to interact with the RDS Data API, including executing statements and managing transactions.

classes.name: RDSDataServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS RDS DataService, providing methods to execute SQL statements and manage transactions.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatement
methods.description: Executes multiple SQL statements in a batch.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes multiple SQL statements in a batch.

methods.name: beginTransactionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously begins a new database transaction.

methods.name: commitTransactionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously commits the current database transaction.

methods.name: executeStatementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a single SQL statement.

methods.name: rollbackTransactionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously rolls back the current transaction.
